annotation.title_clean: DRAFT Compromise Amendments on the Draft Report: Proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union Legislative Acts
annotation.title_en: DRAFT Compromise Amendments on the Draft Report: Proposal for a regulation on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament, Committee on the Internal Market and Consumer Protection (IMCO) and Committee on Civil Liberties, Justice and Home Affairs (LIBE); Rapporteurs Benifei, B. & Tudorache, I.-D.
named_instruments_referenced: WTO Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade
Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU
annotation.summary_en: Consolidated draft compromise amendments by the European Parliament's IMCO and LIBE committees (May 2023) to the proposed EU AI Act. It sets out the Parliament's negotiating text on risk-based obligations for high-risk AI, the notifying authorities and notified bodies that run conformity assessments, the review of prohibited practices, environmental impact measurement and AI literacy duties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States must designate notifying authorities to assess, designate and monitor conformity assessment bodies for high-risk AI
Notified bodies must be independent and impartial and meet NIS2-level cybersecurity requirements
Commission to pursue mutual recognition agreements on conformity assessment under the WTO TBT Agreement
Commission to review Article 5, Article 52 and Annex III at least once a year
Providers and deployers must ensure sufficient AI literacy among their staff
